source_snapshot.test_name_items: Upgrade and Downgrade HIB-CPLD firmware by Web when system is booted
source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    Upgrade / Downgrade HIB-CPLD firmware through web UI
(Need to do AC cycle after flash complete).

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.

deepseek_columns.ai_packages_needed: browser/automation to drive the BMC web-UI flash page + HIB-CPLD image (user provides)
deepseek_columns.ai_commands: -- HIB-CPLD upgrade/downgrade via the BMC web UI: the agent first places the exact user-provided HIB-CPLD image where the web-UIs upload control expects it, then drives the HIB-CPLD flash page (upload image, start update, wait for completion) with the SUT must be booted and the BMC web-UI reachable; an AC cycle is required after flash completes; after completion verify the HIB-CPLD version. Interactive web-UI upload is not a single sshpass one-liner; walk the UI steps after the image is in place.
deepseek_columns.ai_logs_output: return screenshots + the flash-completion status and the HIB-CPLD version shown before/after so the user confirms a successful flash and a clean single reset.
deepseek_columns.risk: RISK: HIB-CPLD firmware flash via web UI is state-changing and can brick the BMC/host if interrupted; AC cycle after flash is mandatory; flash only the user-specified image and do not interrupt mid-flash.

original_test_intent: Perform approved HIB-CPLD firmware upgrade and downgrade through the BMC WebUI while the host is booted, apply the required post-flash AC cycle, and verify active firmware and platform health.
original_method: A human uses the BMC WebUI to upload and commit each approved HIB-CPLD image, observes completion, executes the project-approved AC-cycle method, and checks version and logs.
manual_activity: The source makes the BMC WebUI upload, commit and progress observation the core operation; an engineer must perform it and any physical power handling required by the approved AC-cycle plan.
required_inputs: HIB-CPLD component and current/upgrade/downgrade image matrix with hashes
Vendor WebUI update and activation SOP
AC-cycle controller, off/on timing and count
Post-cycle active-version and host/BMC/HIB health criteria
Known-good recovery image and OOB path
safety_requirements: Use one approved image and unchanged power plan per transition; never automatically retry, reverse or repeat an AC cycle.
Do not infer physical cable removal: this source requires an AC cycle, not the Seq 182 physical-removal method.
Preserve WebUI errors, SEL and power telemetry; a banner before AC is not activation evidence.
Stop on uncertain flash state, power restoration, HIB-CPLD version or platform health.
agent_execution_scope: Prepare immutable image metadata, baseline inventory and evidence capture; monitor approved logs and power telemetry; collect independent post-cycle version and health data.
Do not operate or claim completion of the WebUI core or issue the formal verdict.
engineer_actions: Approve and perform the WebUI transition and exact AC-cycle method/hand-off.
Confirm HIB-CPLD activation and platform health, then issue separate direction verdicts.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The attended WebUI plus AC-cycle outline fits, but browser automation cannot replace the manual core and its clean-single-reset evidence is not in the source.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use the vendor WebUI manually and the approved project AC-cycle mechanism; run the existing read-only version check only after power is restored.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The booted-host, HIB-CPLD WebUI, required AC cycle, script and 5/30-minute values remain.

modernized_recommendation.status: ATTENDED HIB-CPLD WEB UPDATE WITH CONTROLLED AC ACTIVATION
modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Bind the selected image to the HIB-CPLD identity, capture WebUI acceptance/completion, execute one approved AC-cycle plan and verify the active component version plus host/BMC/HIB health through independent interfaces.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: BMC/HIB-CPLD combinations supporting the vendor WebUI workflow and AC activation.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record BMC/WebUI/browser, HIB-CPLD image/component and power-controller versions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Vendor HIB-CPLD WebUI update/activation/recovery documentation and project power SOP.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds immutable component identity, deterministic power plan, independent activation evidence and recovery gates.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Distinguishes a completed upload from active post-AC HIB-CPLD firmware and detects boot/management regressions.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Power mechanism remains project-specific; no unrelated reset or physical-cable rule is imported.

project_override_considerations: Projects may define images, version order, acceptance thresholds and AC-cycle mechanism/timing. Completion applies only to that named plan and cannot claim other HIB-CPLD revisions or power methods.
expected_evidence: Approved HIB-CPLD transition matrix and image hashes
Manual WebUI selection, progress, completion and error capture
Post-cycle active HIB-CPLD version plus platform health

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The master source consistently requires a WebUI flash and an AC cycle. Exact versions, power timing and expanded success criteria are project readiness inputs; the DeepSeek single-reset wording is rejected rather than treated as source truth.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The test intent and destructive sequence are understandable. Missing project inputs do not create permanent BLOCKED under V3.1; the attended WebUI core makes this MANUAL ONLY.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Keeps its component and AC-cycle scope while rejecting browser substitution and unsupported reset wording.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Retains its safety/recovery gates but changes BLOCKED to MANUAL ONLY because the gaps are approvable project inputs.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Separates manual core acceptance from execution readiness and keeps engineer verdict independent.

review_improvement: Makes HIB-CPLD activation after AC observable without inventing a reset requirement or lowering the manual WebUI boundary.
independent_technical_reasoning: The source provides an intelligible firmware lifecycle; project versions and power parameters can be supplied without changing intent. Because an engineer must drive and observe the WebUI core, the proper capability is MANUAL ONLY rather than BLOCKED or PARTIAL.
